mutants.note: noStorage()'s catch is reached only when reading the localStorage global throws; with the mutant it returns false, but every later localStorage access (usageOptedOut, record, readUsage, setUsageOptOut) sits in its own try/catch and falls back to the same result the noStorage()=true path gives (not opted out, {} read, nothing written), so no caller can observe it.

No test made getItem throw and asked usageOptedOut(); added 'a store whose reads throw is never read as an opt-out' plus a reload test. usage_contract.mjs already guards the 998 identical copies repo-wide.
No test stored valid JSON that is not an object (null makes record() throw on current[event]); added a case storing null, 5, true, "text", [], [1,2]. Same contract guards the class.

real_defects.issue: money()/money2() took the sign from the raw amount and the digits from the rounded one, so money2(-0.001) printed "-$0.00" and money(-0.4) "-$0": a profit or gap that is zero to the cent read as a loss. The same shape was in 705 formatters across 425 ventures (649 of them rounding); all swept, and platform/ci/check_negative_zero_money.py now fails on a new copy.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
